patch.value: Execute bounded recursive collection, training, evaluation and promotion

Implement the full execution loop specified in RECURSIVE_TRAINING.md. Existing pm-rl-yi7j supplies lineage and promotion gates; it does not execute training. Add a TypeScript/Rust controller with local Docker Compose trainer adapters, content-addressed checkpoints, atomic budget reservations, idempotent resumption, cancellation and held-out evaluation. Companion pm-cli-website-eag2 and pm-cli-website-hktr.

Two real training generations produce changed checkpoints and collect with the promoted successor; a bounded LLM adapter demonstrates parameter updates; two controllers launch a job once; crash and cancellation drills preserve artifacts and budget integrity; contamination and invalid checkpoints stop promotion; every authored source passes exact four-metric coverage and documented-surface gates

value.author: codex-pm-native
value.text: Execution foundation is implemented under child pm-rl-s44k: a real bounded TypeScript contextual-bandit policy-gradient adapter supplies promoted checkpoints to successor collection. RECURSIVE_TRAINING.md distinguishes this numerical adapter from the remaining SDK-persisted job controller, atomic approved-budget reservations, owner leases, crash/cancellation recovery, Compose isolation and LLM parameter-update acceptance. The epic remains open. Repeated evaluation is adaptive validation, so a separate final benchmark is still required.

value.author: pi-agent
value.text:
Promotion gate design (closing the recursive self-improvement loop):

PROPERTY: A candidate policy is promoted ONLY when its held-out expected reward exceeds the incumbent's by at least the effect threshold, with confidence >= 1-alpha, using at least minSamples evaluation episodes, AND the held-out evaluation set is not reachable from the candidate's training data. The default answer is NO: absent, unreadable, self-referential, incomparable, or statistically insufficient evidence promotes NOTHING.

DOMAIN: Pairs of bounded-reward evaluation evidence records (candidate + incumbent) carrying a finite empirical mean, a finite sample count, and declared reward bounds [lo, hi]; a confidence level in (0,1), a minimum sample count >= 1, an effect threshold >= 0; and a contamination verdict (null = isolated).

STATISTICAL CRITERION: Hoeffding inequality for bounded random variables. Distribution-free, valid for any bounded objective a caller pins a range to, conservative for small samples (the property a fail-closed gate wants). epsilon = (hi - lo) * sqrt(ln(2/alpha)/(2n)). Promote iff candidate lower confidence bound exceeds incumbent upper confidence bound by the effect threshold (maximize; inverted for minimize). Chosen over a distribution-assuming bound because RL reward distributions are unknown and a single lucky sample must not promote; Hoeffding needs no distribution assumption and is loosest exactly when samples are few.

WHAT IT BUYS: with probability >= 1-alpha, a promoted candidate's TRUE expected reward exceeds the incumbent's by at least the effect threshold. A single lucky sample, a regression, a contaminated held-out set, and a sub-threshold improvement are all refused.

WHAT IT DOES NOT BUY: protection against a held-out set semantically duplicated under a different name (the contamination gate's job, consumed not rebuilt); non-stationary environments; unbiased estimates after repeated selection (adaptive validation, not a final benchmark); reward hacking on the held-out set itself.

HELD-OUT ISOLATION IS STRUCTURAL: the bandit adapter validates training and evaluation example identities disjoint before any gradient, so the held-out set is unreachable from the training loop by construction; the gate's contamination verdict is null. The persisted promoteGeneration flow already enforces the same via findContaminationPath over provenance edges.

LINEAGE: every promotion and every refusal is recorded. In the recursive loop (bandit adapter) each generation receipt carries promoted + refusalReason + the sampled held-out means; the generations array is the auditable chain from generation 0 to N. Transitive invalidation uses the existing buildLineageAncestry forward propagation and invalidate.ts (not rebuilt).

REMAINING ON THIS EPIC: the durable execution controller (Docker Compose trainer, atomic budget reservations, owner leases, crash/cancellation recovery, LLM parameter-update acceptance) and wiring the statistical gate into the persisted rl generation promote command's scores contract remain separate slices. This delivery closes the recursive self-improvement loop's promotion decision; it does not deliver the full durable controller.

value.note: promotion with NO candidate evaluation evidence is refused (fail-closed default is no)

a regressing generation is refused by the gate and the refusal reason is recorded as lineage; a single lucky held-out sample cannot promote below the gate minimum sample count; the gate refusal is attributable

value.author: pi-agent
value.text: Audit 2026-09-13: EXISTS — the bounded TypeScript contextual-bandit adapter is implemented and merged (bandit.ts, PR #33, pm-rl-s44k now closed); the fail-closed statistically bounded promotion gate is implemented and merged (promotion.ts, PR #35, pm-rl-gr7j closed); contamination and invalid checkpoints stop promotion (promotion.test.ts); 323 tests pass with 100/100/100/100 coverage across 20 source files. REMAINS — the durable execution controller is not implemented: no Docker Compose trainer adapter, no atomic budget reservations, no owner leases, no crash/cancellation recovery drills; a bounded LLM adapter demonstrating parameter updates is not implemented (the bandit is a numerical adapter, not an LLM trainer); two controllers launching a job once is not demonstrated. These are the remaining slices named in the item description and the 2026-09-10 pi-agent comment.

| Contamination/invalid checkpoints refuse | lineage.ts, promotion.ts, checkpoint-artifacts.ts, process.ts; tests for each | Corpus split must bind item/content identities and refuse overlap before training; retain typed checkpoint failures |
| Full four-metric coverage/docs | package coverageGate sources=[.] and thresholds 100/100/100/100; docstring gate | Add all new code to measured scope, behavioral revert proofs, npm/Bun and isolated-identity gates |

Implementation decision: extend the existing proven durable controller with a bounded tracker-corpus configuration builder and CLI entry point, rather than duplicate leases/jobs/gates. Snapshot only selected local tracker; seal content identities; no hosted sources. Public-corpus learning outcome will be reported even if no candidate improves. Taking over the old epic claim for the explicitly assigned work; no child item is closed.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Implemented a Git-independent SDK corpus snapshot builder plus rl corpus build. Selected task is deliberately weak and explicit: closed-status recognition from normalized title length, with no status feature. Projected-input groups cannot cross train/held-out; source text and paths are not retained. A content seal binds the projected corpus, datasets, environment and durable seed; edited or renamed held-out leaks refuse before training. Existing run/resume owns all jobs, reservations, leases and promotion gates. Planned real corpus is the committed public pm-ops tracker at eba7d5262fd75e67afce0caad29dae7dc7dfbaeb, copied read-only into a plain scratch directory. Bounds are fixed in examples/loop-corpus.json before execution; no gate thresholds are weakened. Metrics will be compared with the fixed closed/open classifiers and described as finite-corpus adaptive validation, not broad predictive skill.

value.text: The first real public-corpus run is retained as a null: 105 training/41 held-out items (36 closed held-out); one optimizer update changed the checkpoint from sha256:17493680209cdf2fc86126ff2ad0b7bb6063ae24ce00f28f931224bb5ab2fd11 to sha256:30472bb0144f5b6c9a4777da6a9899bd9acec3df704468b3ec1493d8980b5bc2. Candidate sampled held-out reward 0.511125 failed the unchanged 0.95 confidence/0.01 effect gate. Zero promotions; no successor collected. The reservation settled once. Added bounded importance-weighted repeated optimizer updates (fit_steps 1–256; old default remains one), explicit matching step reservations, per-update measured charges, and finite-difference objective verification. The next independent run uses eight updates per generation and a separately declared 16-update allowance; neither data nor promotion thresholds change. This is learner capacity work following a reported null, not retrospective promotion.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Real non-git public-tracker acceptance completed: same sealed 105 training/41 held-out items. Eight-update gen 1: source sha256:17493680209cdf2fc86126ff2ad0b7bb6063ae24ce00f28f931224bb5ab2fd11 -> candidate sha256:2df645949b852625c2acdc20bf5232620cac8c87d1ab1f8f85c4221da14ac605; exact held-out reward 0.5979768545815656, sampled incumbent/candidate 0.499825/0.59765, promoted. Gen 2 collected with that promoted digest -> sha256:3e31b06286e99d6b3d73486216f98f0c6d519228cac4bcbefc56f4945c292863; exact reward 0.6810112913266447, sampled 0.5951/0.685825, promoted. Both jobs settled eight optimizer updates once. 512 collected actions; 40,000 evaluation policy episodes per side per generation; elapsed 124.736 seconds. Resume verified two generations and byte-identical checkpoints; status agreed. All 300 copied source tracker files remained byte-identical and read-only. Improvement is only versus the 0.5 stochastic seed: the always-closed baseline is 36/41=0.8780487805 and learned greedy classifiers merely tie it. No useful forecasting or population/generalization claim. docs/tracker-loop-evidence.json retains digests, resource use, the initial null and measured implementation hashes. Two behavioral reverts (seal guard and old one-update fitter) fail with unchanged tests in isolated snapshots. Full release gates are still running; no pass claim yet.
